readings.note: Reclaimed 1,610,587,371 bytes (1.5000 GiB) of REBUILDABLE derived caches only, to clear ckpt_store_capacity_gate for the approved Phase-B session. No checkpoint, scientific artifact, relay_retired object or sibling-project asset was touched, and the measured 6 GiB ckpt-store working margin was not shrunk.

readings.label: after-checkpoint-cleanup-20260911
readings.note: Authorized local cleanup after the root filesystem reached 100% and killed a pod-like sweep mid-run, leaving 869 gitignored artifacts (5.9 GiB) displaced in the simulator's hide directory and truncating two tracked files to zero bytes. All 869 were restored (0 quarantined) and both tracked files recovered from git; the C1 battery, the staged Stage-1 checkpoint config and the frozen-asset verifier were re-checked by hash and by the real gate. Deleted: 17 registered units, 48.44 GiB -- ten trainer_state.pt files (optimizer/scheduler/RNG state) from COMPLETED experiments E2p1/E4/E6b/E7, and seven intermediate step checkpoints of E2 phase 1, a closed diagnostic recorded as 'in current lineage: no'. NO model weights of any protected class were deleted: every canonical, control and reproducibility_required MODEL is retained at its canonical path, as is the 13 GiB of pytest tmp_path scratch's replacement policy. Five tombstones record the criterion, the surviving evidence and reconstruction cost; the registry marks each unit present_local=false rather than forgetting it.

filesystem_root.note: before is the 100%-full state that killed the sweep; the intermediate step after removing 13 GiB of pytest tmp_path scratch was 12.28 GiB free

ckpt_store.note: same filesystem as the repository, /tmp and aad-scratch: one device, /dev/nvme0n1p3
ckpt_store._measurement_vs_threshold: 60.71 GiB is a MEASUREMENT of free space after this cleanup. 40 GiB was the target this cleanup was asked to reach. 24 GiB is a separate ADMISSION THRESHOLD that one operation -- the pod-like sweep -- checks before it moves anything, derived from that sweep's own footprint. Three different numbers with three different owners: none of them licenses the others, and a future operation with a larger footprint needs its own threshold rather than inheriting this one.
ckpt_store.gate_required_gib_meaning: the 40 GiB floor this cleanup was asked to clear, not a standing admission gate
